In his statement, Minister Shahid called for Governments to address the conditions that lead to crimes, by identifying what needs to be changed though means of a holistic and strategic approach. He also highlighted the importance of juvenile justice and good governance, as means to tackle crime. Furthermore, Minister emphasized the need for youth engagement in meaningful ways, while also preventing children from getting involved in criminal activities.

Minister Shahid elaborated on the measures taken by the current Administration of President Solih in preventing crimes and guaranteeing protection through a renewed focus on good governance, rule of law and reforming the judiciary. He also reiterated the involvement and support needed from the communities in tackling crime.

The debate was organized by the President of the United Nations General Assembly, with the objective of providing Member States with the opportunity to discuss the need to and ways in which to prioritize safety and security, while considering how organized and transnational crimes exploit and intensify local vulnerabilities.

en.title: Minister Shahid calls for countries to renew cooperation and commitment to urgent climate action during the virtual Ministerial Roundtable hosted by the United States today
en.description: Minister Shahid delivered an intervention at the roundtable, speaking about the impacts of climate change and the Maldives' position for COP26
en.body:
Minister Shahid delivered an intervention at the roundtable, speaking about the impacts of climate change and the Maldives' position for COP26

Minister of Foreign Affairs, Abdulla Shahid, today participated in a ministerial meeting hosted by the United States Special Presidential Envoy for Climate, John Kerry. During the virtual session, he was joined by Ministers from Sweden, Austria, Greece, Finland, Monaco, Switzerland, Estonia, Madagascar, Romania, North Macedonia, Malta, St Kitts & Nevis, Luxembourg, Kosovo, Guyana, Kazakhstan, Grenada, Guatemala, Federated States of Micronesia, Senegal and Latvia.

Minister Shahid delivered an intervention at the roundtable, speaking about the impacts of climate change and the Maldives' position for COP26. He welcomed the USA on their decision to rejoin the Paris Agreement and praised the US Government for their new and ambitious commitments towards bolder climate action. He further highlighted the many negative impacts that Small Island Developing States (SIDS) face due to climate change and how it is also a threat to our very survival. He called on both, the developed and developing countries to work for stronger climate action, given that the threat could only be countered effectively through concerted action.

Minister Shahid also highlighted that Maldives leads by example and noted the many ambitious goals we have set out, including the plan to phase out single use plastic by 2023 and achieving net zero emissions by 2030. Finally, he called for scaled up cooperation and recommitment by all countries towards urgent action in the lead up to COP26.

The Twenty Sixth Conference of Parties to the Untied Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP26) will be held in Glasgow, United Kingdom from 1-12 November 2021. This Ministerial Roundtable was convened as part of the activities leading up to COP26. The Maldives stands ready to work with its international partners in raising ambition and momentum in the lead up to and during COP26.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid concludes Official Visit to Kuwait
en.description: The purpose of the visit was to reaffirm the commitment of the Maldives to foster the existing close relationship between Maldives and Kuwait
en.body:
The purpose of the visit was to reaffirm the commitment of the Maldives to foster the existing close relationship between Maldives and Kuwait

Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid has today concluded his Official Visit to the State of Kuwait. The purpose of the visit was to reaffirm the commitment of the Maldives to foster the existing close relationship between Maldives and Kuwait, and discuss and explore additional areas for cooperation.

During the visit, Minister Shahid called on the Prime Minister of Kuwait, His Highness Sheikh Sabah Khaled Al-Hamad Al-Sabah and delivered a letter from the President of the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih to the Amir of the State of Kuwait, His Highness Sheikh Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah.

Minister Shahid also met with his counterpart, Foreign Minister and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs of the State of Kuwait, Dr. Ahmad Nasser Al-Mohammad Al-Ahmed Al-Jaber Al-Sabah; Minister of Commerce and Industry of the State of Kuwait Dr. Abdullah Issa Al-Salman and the Minister of Finance and Minister of State for Economic and Investment Affairs of the State of Kuwait Khalifa Musaed Hamada. At the meetings, Minister Shahid briefed the Kuwaiti officials on the situation of the Covid-19 pandemic on the Maldives, and the way forward for the Maldives, going ahead, directed by the Maldives’ National Resilience and Recovery 2020-2022 plan. Ongoing development cooperation projects, and future prospects for collaboration and exchange between the Maldives and Kuwait were also discussed during the meetings.

During the visit, Minister Shahid signed two Memorandums of Understandings on behalf of the Government of Maldives. The two agreements concluded were a ‘Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the State of Kuwait’, and a ‘Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the State of Kuwait in the Field of Tourism’.

Minister Shahid was accompanied by the Secretary, Multilateral of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Dr. Hala Hameed; Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Moomina Ibrahim; and Assistant Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Salman Zaki.

Maldives and Kuwait have enjoyed a close partnership since the establishment of diplomatic relations between the two countries on 1 December 1977. Kuwait has been an invaluable development partner of the Maldives, and has provided generous support and assistance to the Maldives over the years, most notably through the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan
en.description: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to the Foreign Minister of Pakistan

Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid sent a message of condolence to the Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Islamic Republic of Pakistan, Makhdoom Shah Mahmood Qureshi, , following the terror attack at Serena Hotel in Quetta.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“The Maldives condemns in strongest terms, the terrorist attack at the Serena Hotel in Quetta that claimed at least 4 lives and wounded several.

On behalf of the Government and the people of the Maldives, and on my own behalf, allow me to extend our heartfelt condolences to the victims, and members of the affected and bereaved families.

The Maldives denounces violent extremism and terrorism in all its forms and manifestations.”

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid meets with the Foreign Minister and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs of Kuwait
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid meets with the Foreign Minister and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs of Kuwait
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid meets with the Foreign Minister and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs of Kuwait

Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid had a meeting with the Foreign Minister and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs of the State of Kuwait, Dr. Ahmad Nasser Al-Mohammad Al-Ahmed Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, in Kuwait City, today.

During the meeting, the two Ministers spoke on the long history of cooperation between Maldives and Kuwait, and the cordial people-to-people links and business-to-business ties enjoyed by the two countries. Minister Shahid made special note of the generous support and assistance provided to the Maldives through the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development, and expressed gratitude on behalf of the government and people of the Maldives for the invaluable contributions made by Kuwait towards the socio-economic development of the Maldives, over the years.

The two Ministers exchanged perspectives on the situation of the Covid-19 pandemic, and discussed strategies to build back better, and become more resilient. Minister Shahid briefed on the Maldives’ National Resilience and Recovery 2020-2022 plan, which focuses on economic diversification and strengthening the social and governance sectors. The two Ministers reiterated their commitment to fortify and further diversify the close bilateral relationship between Maldives and Kuwait, and reaffirmed confidence toward working together in the multinational arena on areas of shared interest.

Minister Shahid was accompanied at the meeting by the Secretary, Multilateral of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Dr. Hala Hameed, Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Moomina Ibrahim, and Assistant Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Salman Zaki.

en.title: Maldives and Kuwait sign two MoUs to fortify cooperation between their respective Ministries of Foreign Affairs and in the field of Tourism
en.description: Maldives and Kuwait sign two MoUs to fortify cooperation between their respective Ministries of Foreign Affairs
en.body:
Maldives and Kuwait sign two MoUs to fortify cooperation between their respective Ministries of Foreign Affairs

The Government of Maldives and the Government of Kuwait has signed two Memorandums of Understanding, at a ceremony held in the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the State of Kuwait, in Kuwait City, on Tuesday evening.

The two agreements concluded were a ‘Memorandum of Understanding on Cooperation between the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the State of Kuwait’, and a ‘Memorandum of Understanding between the Government of the Republic of Maldives and the Government of the State of Kuwait in the Field of Tourism’. The MoUs were signed by the Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid on behalf of the Maldives, and Foreign Minister and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs of the State of Kuwait, Dr. Ahmad Nasser Al-Mohammad Al-Ahmed Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, on behalf of Kuwait.

The MoUs will further strengthen the close ties of friendship between Maldives and Kuwait, develop cooperation in the field of tourism, promote further collaborations and exchanges, and facilitate the effective implementation of key understandings and agreements reached by the Governments of the two countries.

dv.title: ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ކުވައިތާ ދެމެދު 2 އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ އެއްގައި ސޮއިކޮށްފި
dv.description: ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ކުވައިތާ ދެމެދު 2 އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ އެއްގައި ސޮއިކޮށްފި
dv.body:
ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ކުވައިތާ ދެމެދު 2 އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ އެއްގައި ސޮއިކޮށްފި

ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ސްޓޭޓް އޮފް ކުވައިތާ ދެމެދު 2 މެމޮރެންޑަމް އޮފް އަންޑަސްޓޭންޑިންގ އެއްގައި ސޮއިކޮށްފިއެވެ. މި އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ ތަކުގައި ސޮއިކޮށްފައިވަނީ ރޭ ކުވައިތު ސިޓީގައި ހުންނަ ކުވައިތުގެ މިނިސްޓްރީ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒްގައި ބޭއްވި ރަސްމިއްޔާތެއްގައެވެ.

މި 2 އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ އަކީ "މެމޮރެންޑަމް އޮފް އަންޑަރސްޓޭންޑިންގ އޮން ކޯޕަރޭޝަން ބިޓްވީން މިނިސްޓްރީ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް އޮފް ދަ ރިޕަބްލިކް އޮފް މޯލްޑިވްސް އެންޑް ދަ މިނިސްޓްރީ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް އޮފް ދަ ސްޓޭޓް އޮފް ކުވައިތު" އާއި "މެމޮރެންޑަމް އޮފް އަންޑަސްޓޭންޑިންގ ބިޓްވީން ދަ ގަވަރމަންޓް އޮފް މޯލްޑިވްސް އެންޑް ދަ ގަވަރމަންޓް އޮފް ދަ ސްޓޭޓް އޮފް ކުވައިތު އިން ދަ ފީލްޑް އޮފް ޓޫރިޒަމް" އެވެ. މި އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ ތަކުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ފަރާތުން ސޮއިކުރެއްވީ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު އެވެ. އަދި ކުވައިތުގެ ފަރާތުން ސޮއިކުރެއްވީ އެޤައުމުގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް އަދި މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ސްޓޭޓް ފޮރ ކެބިނެޓް އެފެއަރޒް ޑރ. އަޙްމަދު ނާސިރް އަލް މުޙައްމަދު އަލް އަޙްމަދު އަލް ޖާބިރް އަލް ސަބާޙް އެވެ.

މި އެމް.އޯ.ޔޫ ތަކުގެ ސަބަބުން ދެޤައުމުގެ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ބަދަހިވެ، ފަތުރުވެރިކަމުގެ ދާއިރާގައި އެކުގައި މަސައްކަތްކުރުމުގެ ފުރުސަތު ހުޅުވި އަދި ކުރިއަށް އޮތްތަނުގައި ދެޤައުމުގެ ސަރުކާރުތަކުގެ މެދުގައި ވެވޭ އެއްބަސްވުންތައް ތަންފީޒުކުރުމަށް އިތުރަށް ފަސޭހަ ވެގެންދާނެއެވެ.

dv.title: ކުވައިތުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރާ މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި
dv.description: ކުވައިތުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރާ މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި
dv.body:
ކުވައިތުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރާ މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި

ކުވައިތުގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް އަދި މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ސްޓޭޓް ފޮރ ކެބިނެޓް އެފެއަރޒް ޑރ. އަޙްމަދު ނާސިރް އަލް މުޙައްމަދު އަލް އަޙްމަދު އަލް ޖާބިރް އަލް ސަބާޙް އާއި މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު ރޭ ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފިއެވެ.

މި ބައްދަލުކުރެއްވުމުގައި ދެޤައުމުގެ ދެމެދުގައިވާ އަޚުވަންތަ ގުޅުމާއި ވިޔަފާރީގެ ގުޅުންތަކާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން ދެބޭފުޅުން މަޝްވަރާކުރެއްވިއެވެ. އަދި ކުވައިތު ފަންޑް ފޮރ އަރަބް އިކޮނޮމިކް ޑިވެލޮޕްމަންޓުން ރާއްޖެއަށް ވަމުންދާ އެހީތެރިކަން ފާހަގަކުރައްވައި، ރާއްޖޭގެ އިޖްތިމާޢީ އަދި އިޤްތިޞާދީ ތަރައްޤީއަށް ކުވައިތުގެ ސަރުކާރުން ވެދެއްވާ އެހީތެރިކަމަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ޝުކުރު އަދާކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

މީގެ އިތުރުން ކޮވިޑް-19ގެ ސަބަބުން ލިބިފައިވާ ގެއްލުންތަކާއި، އެގެއްލުންތަކުން އަރައިގަތުމަށް ކުރެވިދާނެ މަސައްކަތްތަކާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން ދެ ވަޒީރުން މަޝްވަރާކުރެއްވިއެވެ. މި މަޝްވަރާތަކުގައި، ރާއްޖޭގެ އިޤްތިޞާދު ޑައިވަރސިފައިކޮށް، އިޖްތިމާޢި އަދި ހިންގުމުގެ ދާއިރާ ހަރުދާއިރާތައް ހަރުދަނާކުރުމަށް އެކަށައަޅާފައިވާ ނޭޝަނަލް ރިޒިލިއަންސް އެންޑް ރިކަވަރީ ޕްލޭންއާއި ބެހޭ މައުލޫމާތު މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ވަނީ ކުވައިތުގެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރަށް އަރުވާފައެވެ.

މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދުގެ އަރިހުގައި ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގެންނެވީ މިނިސްޓްރީގެ ސެކްރެޓަރީ – މަލްޓިލޭޓަރަލް ޑރ. ހާލާ ހަމީދު އާއި ޑިރެކްޓަރ މޫމިނާ އިބްރާހިމް އަދި އެސިސްޓަންޓް ޑިރެކްޓަރ އަހްމަދު ސަލްމާން ޒަކީއެވެ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid calls on the Prime Minister of Kuwait
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid calls on the Prime Minister of Kuwait
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid calls on the Prime Minister of Kuwait

Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid called on the Prime Minister of Kuwait, His Highness Sheikh Sabah Khaled Al-Hamad Al-Sabah today and delivered a letter from the President of the Republic of Maldives, His Excellency President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih to the Amir of the State of Kuwait, His Highness Sheikh Nawaf Al-Ahmad Al-Jaber Al-Sabah.

During the meeting, Minister Shahid conveyed warm greetings from President Solih to the Prime Minister and the friendly people of Kuwait. Minister Shahid highlighted that the close relationship enjoyed between the two countries is one which is based on mutual trust and respect, rooted in the cultural and historical links and shared Islamic values. On behalf of the Government and the people of Maldives, Minister Shahid expressed sincere gratitude and appreciation for the consistent and constant support provided by Kuwait, through the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development, in helping the Maldives achieve its socio-economic goals. Furthermore, Minister Shahid underscored that the Maldives remains one of the hardest-hit countries from the Covid-19 pandemic, and briefed the Prime Minister on President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih’s response and recovery plan.

Prime Minister Al-Sabah commended the fast and effective measures adopted by the Government of Maldives to contain and control the Covid-19 pandemic and revive the tourism sector. Prime Minster also affirmed Kuwait’s commitment to further enhance the longstanding strong bonds of friendships between the two countries and underscored the readiness of the Government of Kuwait, through the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development to assist the Maldives in its developmental endeavours.

During the call, Minister Shahid and Prime Minister Al-Sabah reiterated the commitment of both Governments to continue working closely together, bilaterally and in the international fora, on issues of shared relevance.

Minister Shahid was accompanied at the meeting by the Secretary, Multilateral of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Dr. Hala Hameed, Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Moomina Ibrahim, and Assistant Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Salman Zaki

dv.title: ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު ކުވައިތުގެ ބޮޑުވަޒީރުގެ އަރިހަށް ޒިޔާރަތްކުރައްވައިފި
dv.description: ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު ކުވައިތުގެ ބޮޑުވަޒީރުގެ އަރިހަށް ޒިޔާރަތްކުރައްވައިފި
dv.body:
ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު ކުވައިތުގެ ބޮޑުވަޒީރުގެ އަރިހަށް ޒިޔާރަތްކުރައްވައިފި

މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު، ކުވައިތުގެ ބޮޑުވަޒީރު ޝައިޚް ސަބާޙް ޚާލިދު އަލް ޙަމަދު އަލް ސަބާޙްގެ އަރިހަށް މިއަދު ޒިޔާރަތްކުރައްވައި، ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފިއެވެ. މި ޒިޔާރަތުގައި ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާ އިބްރާހިމް މުޙައްމަދު ސާލިޙް، ކުވައިތުގެ އަމީރު ޝައިޚް ނަވާފް އަލް އަޙްމަދު އަލް ޖާބިރް އަލް ސަބާޙްއަށް ފޮނުއްވި ސިޓީފުޅެއް، މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ވަނީ ބޮޑުވަޒީރަށް އަރުވާފައެވެ.

މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ވަނީ ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާގެ ފަރާތްޕުޅުން ކުވައިތުގެ ބޮޑުވަޒީރަށާއި ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ހެޔޮ އެދުންތައް އަރިސްކުރައްވާފައެވެ. އަދި ދެޤައުމުގެ މެދުގައި އޮންނަ އަޚުވަންތަ ގުޅުމަކީ އެއް ޤައުމުން އަނެއް ޤައުމަށް ކުރާ އިތުބާރާއި ޤަދަރުގެ މައްޗަށް ބިނާވެގެންވާ، ދީނީ އަދި ސަޤާފީ ގުޅުމެއްކަމަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ވިދާޅުވިއެވެ. އަދި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ އިޤްތިޞާދީ އަދި އިޖްތިމާޢީ ތަރައްޤީއަށް ކުވައިތު ފަންޑް ފޮރ އަރަބް އިކޮނޮމިކް ޑިވެލޮޕްމަންޓް އާއި ކުވައިތުގެ ސަރުކާރުން އަބަދުވެސް ފޯރުކޮށްދެއްވަމުންދާ އެހީތެރިކަމަށްޓަކައި މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ޝުކުރު އަދާކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

ކޮވިޑް-19ގެ ސަބަބުން ރާއްޖެއަށް ކުރި އަސަރުތަކާއި އަދި ބަލިމަޑުކަމުން އަރައިގަތުމަށް ރައީސުލްޖުމްހޫރިއްޔާ އިބްރާހިމް މުހައްމަދު ސާލިހް އެޅުއްވި ފިޔަވަޅުތަކާ ބެހޭ މައުލޫމާތު، ކުވައިތުގެ ބޮޑުވަޒީރަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ހިއްސާކުރެއްވިއެވެ. ކުވައިތުގެ ބޮޑުވަޒީރުގެ ވާހަކަފުޅުގައި، ކޮވިޑް-19 އިން ރައްކާތެރިވުމަށާއި، ބަލިމަޑުކަމުން އަރައިގަނެ، އިޤްތިޞާދު ހުޅުވާލައި އަދި ފަތުރުވެރިކަން އަލުން ކޮޅަށް ޖެހުމަށް ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރުން ކުރެއްވި މަސައްކަތްތަކަށް ތައުރީފްކުރެއްވިއެވެ. އަދި ދެޤައުމުގެ ދެމެދުގައި އޮތް ޒަމާންވީ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ކުރިއެރުމަށް ކުވައިތު ސަރުކާރުން މަސައްކަތްކުރައްވާނެކަމުގެ ޔަޤީންކަން ބޮޑުވަޒީރު ދެއްވައި، ކުރިއަށް އޮތްތަނުގައިވެސް ކުވައިތު ފަންޑުގެ އެހީތެރިކަން ލިބޭނެކަމަށް ވިދާޅުވިއެވެ.

މީގެ އިތުރުން ދެޤައުމުގެ ގުޅުން ބަދަހިކޮށް، ބައިނަލްއަޤްވާމީ މަސްރަހުގައި އެކުގައި ގުޅިގެން މަސައްކަތްކުރުމާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން ދެބޭފުޅުން މަޝްވަރާކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދުގެ އަރިހުގައި ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގެންނެވީ މިނިސްޓްރީގެ ސެކްރެޓަރީ – މަލްޓިލޭޓަރަލް ޑރ. ހާލާ ހަމީދު އާއި ޑިރެކްޓަރ މޫމިނާ އިބްރާހިމް އަދި އެސިސްޓަންޓް ޑިރެކްޓަރ އަހްމަދު ސަލްމާން ޒަކީއެވެ.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid departs to Kuwait on an Official Visit
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid departs to Kuwait on an Official Visit
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid departs to Kuwait on an Official Visit

Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, on Monday, departed on an Official Visit to the State of Kuwait.

During the visit, Minister Shahid will meet with his counterpart, Foreign Minister and Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs of the State of Kuwait, Dr. Ahmad Nasser Al-Mohammad Al-Ahmed Al-Jaber Al-Sabah, and other senior officials of Kuwait, and discuss on-going development cooperation projects, as well as relevant bilateral and multilateral issues and priorities.

Minister Shahid is accompanied by the Secretary, Multilateral of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Dr. Hala Hameed; Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives, Moomina Ibrahim; and Assistant Director at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Ahmed Salman Zaki.

en.title: Inclusive Education Support Units in Afeefuddin School and Hafiz Ahmed School established under Indian Grant Assistance inaugurated
en.description: Inclusive Education Support Units in Afeefuddin School and Hafiz Ahmed School established under Indian Grant Assistance inaugurated
en.body:
Inclusive Education Support Units in Afeefuddin School and Hafiz Ahmed School established under Indian Grant Assistance inaugurated

A virtual ceremony to mark the inauguration of the Establishment of Inclusive Education Support Units in Afeefuddin School, HDh. Kulhudhuffushi and Hafiz Ahmed School, Gn. Fuvahmulah was held today. This project was funded with a grant of 1.6 million Rufiyaa, under the Indian Grant Assistance of 106 million Rufiyaa.

The ceremony was attended by the Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid, the Minister of Education Dr. Aishath Ali, Honourable Members of Parliament of the respective constituencies and High Commissioner of India to the Maldives Sunjay Sudhir.

Speaking at the event, Minister Shahid highlighted the importance of designing schools and classes in such a way that all children feel a sense of belonging, thus instilling good values that enable children to grow and become valuable contributors to their communities in the near future. Under this project, the human resource capacity of the Inclusive Education Support Units established in both schools had been strengthened significantly through the provision of specialised training programmes offered to staff members and the procurement of learning materials. In addition, the infrastructure of the Inclusive Education Support Units at both schools have undergone refurbishment, to provide a conducive learning environment for the students and staff of the schools.

The financial support has been provided from the grant assistance of USD 6.9 million (MVR 106 million) granted to the Government of Maldives by the Government of India in March 2019. The aim of the grant assistance is to conduct socio-economic development projects across the country which are of high impact. The projects under this grant are managed by local authorities.

en.title: WHO Representative makes introductory call on Foreign Minister Shahid
en.description: WHO Representative makes introductory call on Foreign Minister Shahid
en.body:
WHO Representative makes introductory call on Foreign Minister Shahid

WHO Representative to the Maldives, Dr. Nazneen Anwar paid an introductory call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid, today, to present her Letter of Appointment.

During the call, Minister Shahid and the Representative discussed the role of WHO in the Maldives in supporting the government in its efforts to reform the health sector and in strengthening the health system. They also conversed on ways to strengthen cooperation between the Government of Maldives and WHO. Their discussion also highlighted the numerous challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic and the economic and social recovery efforts that are underway. Foreign Minister Shahid thanked the WHO for the generous assistance provided to the Maldives during the pandemic, and noted the indispensable role of WHO in overcoming the challenges that we are facing now in addressing the health emergency, as well as in minimizing the long-term socio-economic impact of the global pandemic.

WHO has been an active contributor to the health sector development of the Maldives since 1965.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Zimbabwe
en.description: Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Zimbabwe
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends Independence Day greetings to Zimbabwe

Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid sent a message of felicitations to the Minister of Foreign Affairs and International Trade of the Republic of Zimbabwe, Dr. Frederick Shava, on the occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of Zimbabwe.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

“Let me extend warm greetings and best wishes to Your Excellency, the Government, and the people of Zimbabwe, on the joyous occasion of the Independence Day of the Republic of Zimbabwe. I am confident that the friendly ties between our two countries will continue to expand and flourish in the years ahead.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration.”

dv.title: އިންޑިއާ އެހީގެ ދަށުން އަފީފުއްދީން އަދި ހާފިޒް އަހުމަދު ސްކޫލުގައި ޤާއިމްކުރެވުނު އިންކްލޫސިވް އެޑިއުކޭޝަން ސަޕޯޓް ޔުނިޓްތައް އިފްތިތާހުކޮށްފި
dv.description: އިންޑިއާ އެހީގެ ދަށުން އަފީފުއްދީން އަދި ހާފިޒް އަހުމަދު ސްކޫލުގައި ޤާއިމްކުރެވުނު އިންކްލޫސިވް އެޑިއުކޭޝަން ސަޕޯޓް ޔުނިޓްތައް އިފްތިތާހުކޮށްފި
dv.body:
އިންޑިއާ އެހީގެ ދަށުން އަފީފުއްދީން އަދި ހާފިޒް އަހުމަދު ސްކޫލުގައި ޤާއިމްކުރެވުނު އިންކްލޫސިވް އެޑިއުކޭޝަން ސަޕޯޓް ޔުނިޓްތައް އިފްތިތާހުކޮށްފި

އިންޑިއާގެ 1.6 މިލިއަން ރުފިޔާގެ ހިލޭ އެހީގެ ދަށުން ހދ. ކުޅުދުއްފުށި އަފީފުއްދީން ސްކޫލް އަދި ޏ. ފުވައްމުލަކު ހާފިޒް އަހުމަދު ސްކޫލުގައި "އިންކްލޫސިވް އެޑިއުކޭޝަން ސަޕޯޓް ޔުނިޓް" ޤާއިމްކުރުމުގެ މަޝްރޫއު ނިމި، އެކަން ފާހަގަކުރުމުގެ ގޮތުން ވަރޗުއަލްކޮށް މިއަދު ރަސްމިއްޔާތެއް ބާއްވައިފިއެވެ.

މި ރަސްމިއްޔާތުގައި މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު، މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް އެޑިއުކޭޝަން ޑރ. ޢާއިޝަތު ޢަލީ، ރައްޔިތުންގެ މަޖްލީހުގެ ކުޅުދުއްފުށި އަދި ފުވައްމުލަކަށް ނިސްބަތްވާ މެމްބަރުން އަދި އިންޑިއާއިން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ކަނޑައަޅާފައި ހުންނަވާ ސަފީރު ސަންޖޭ ސުދީރު ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގަތެވެ.

ހަފްލާގައި ވާހަކަފުޅު ދައްކަވަމުން މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ވަނީ، ދަރިވަރުން އެތަނަކަށް ލޯބިޖެހި އެތަނަކަށް އަހުލުވެރި ބައެއްކަމުގައި ދެކޭނެފަދައިން ސްކޫލުތައް ބިނާކޮށް ފަރުމާކުރުމަކީ މުހިއްމުކަމެއްކަމުގައި ފާހަގަކުރައްވާފައެވެ. އަދި އެކަމުގެ ސަބަބުން ކުދިން ބޮޑެތިވެ މުޖުތަމައުއަށް މަންފާކުރުވަނިވި ބައެއްކަމުގައި ވެގެންދާނެކަމަށް މިނިސްޓަރު ފާހަގަކުރެއްވިއެވެ.

މި މަޝްރޫގެ ދަށުން 'އިންކްލޫސިވް އެޑިއުކޭޝަން ސަޕޯޓު ޔުނިޓް'ތައް ޤައިމްކުރުމުގައި އެހީތެރިކަން ފޯރުކޮށް، މި ޔުނިޓުތަކުގައި މަސައްކަތްކުރައްވާ މުވައްޒަފުންނަށް ބޭނުންވާ ތަމްރީން ޕްރޮގްރާމުތައް ހިންގައި، މި ޔުނިޓުތަކަށް ބޭނުންވާ ހާއްސަ މެޓީރިއަލް ފޯރުކޮށްދީފައިވެއެވެ. މި ޔުނިޓުތައް ފަރުމާކުރެވިފައި ހުންނާނީ އުނގެނިގަތުމަށާއި އުނގަންނައިދިނުމަށް ފަސޭހަވާނެ މާހައުލެއް ގާއިމުކުރުމަށެވެ.

މި މަޝްރޫއު ހިންގުނީ ހިލޭ އެހީގެ ގޮތުގައި އިންޑިއާ ސަރުކާރުން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް މާޗް 2019 ގައި ދިން 6.9 މިލިއަން ޑޮލަރު (106 މިލިއަން ރުފިޔާ)ގެ އެހީގެދަށުންނެވެ. އިންޑިއާ ސަރުކާރުގެ މި އެހީގެ ބޭނުމަކީ އިޖްތިމާއީ-އިގްތިސާދީ ކުރިއެރުންތަކަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގައި ހިންގޭ މަޝްރޫތަކަށް ހަރަދުކުރުމެވެ.

en.title: “Let us use solidarity, science and shared solutions to build back better.” - Foreign Minister Shahid speaking at the 2021 ECOSOC Special Ministerial Meeting “A Vaccine for All”
en.description: Minister Shahid participated in the 2021 ECOSOC Special Ministerial Meeting on “A Vaccine for All”.
en.body:
Minister Shahid participated in the 2021 ECOSOC Special Ministerial Meeting on “A Vaccine for All”.

Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid today participated in the 2021 ECOSOC Special Ministerial Meeting on “A Vaccine for All”. The meeting was organized by the United Nations Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC), aimed to address the current efforts in mobilizing a coordinated and coherent global response to the COVID-19 pandemic and the adverse socio-economic impacts on people across the world.

In his statement, Minister Shahid briefed participants on the strategically coordinated steps undertaken by the Government of Maldives in combating the COVID-19 pandemic and providing socioeconomic support for those in need. He also appreciated the generous assistance and aid extended to the Maldives by bilateral and multilateral partners in terms of grants and concessional loans, which helped to establish a balance between public health and economic resilience.

Minister Shahid also noted that 60 percent of the Maldivian population have completed the first-dose of COVID-19 vaccination, including foreigners residing in Maldives, irrespective of their nationality. Furthermore, Minister called to take concrete steps in order to facilitate fair and equitable access to vaccines, while considering the unique situations of different countries. He also reiterated the need for solidarity, science and shared solutions to build back better from the impacts of COVID-19.

This Ministerial Meeting allowed leaders from the world to converse on this global topic virtually and push for a global commitment towards equitable and timely distribution of COVID-19 vaccines through accelerated international cooperation and assistance.

en.title: Foreign Minister meets with the External Affairs Minister of India
en.description: Foreign Minister meets with the External Affairs Minister of India
en.body:
Foreign Minister meets with the External Affairs Minister of India

Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid met with the External Affairs Minister of India Dr. S. Jaishankar, today.

During the meeting held at Hyderabad House, Minister Jaishankar welcomed Minister Shahid on his first visit to New Delhi since January 2020. Minister Shahid thanked Minister Jaishankar for the warm welcome and generous hospitality, extended to him and his delegation.

Both Ministers also discussed current situation of Covid-19, and vaccination programmes. Minister Shahid thanked Government of India for the assistance provided to people of Maldives during the pandemic. The External Affairs Minister assured Minister Shahid of India’s ongoing support for the socio-economic development of the Maldives, including the uninterrupted supply of essential commodities.

en.title: Minister Shahid speaks at the Raisina Dialogue Session entitled “Financing the Sun: Solar Energy Accessible to All”
en.description: Minister Shahid speaks at the Raisina Dialogue Session entitled “Financing the Sun: Solar Energy Accessible to All”
en.body:
Minister Shahid speaks at the Raisina Dialogue Session entitled “Financing the Sun: Solar Energy Accessible to All”

The Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid highlighted the difficulties faced by countries in accessing financing for renewable energy. In this context, the Minister noted that complex procedures, limited domestic resources, high debt burdens, as challenges faced by countries – especially smaller countries.

Minister Shahid noted that the Government is constantly working towards shifting to cleaner methods of energy production. He also noted that the Maldives has announced an updated Nationally Determined Contribution in December 2020, to achieve net zero emissions by 2030. Minister Shahid highlighted that while this was an ambitious target, Maldives is working with the international community to achieve it.

Chief Executive Officer of Children’s Investment Fund Foundation Kate Hampton, and the Director General of International Solar Alliance Ajay Mathur joined the Minister on the panel. Programme Manager at Sustainable Energy for All, India, Kanika Chawla moderated the panel .

The Raisina Dialogue is an annual conference hosted by the Observer Research Foundation, in collaboration with the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. The Minister is participating in the Raisina Dialogue on the invitation of the President of the Observer Research Foundation, Mr. Samir Saran. The 2021 edition of the Raisina Dialogue is being held virtually from 13-15 April 2021, due to extenuating circumstances related to the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic.

dv.title: ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު އިންޑިއާގެ އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއަރޒް މިނިސްޓަރާ ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި
dv.description: ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު އިންޑިއާގެ އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއަރޒް މިނިސްޓަރާ ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި
dv.body:
ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު އިންޑިއާގެ އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއަރޒް މިނިސްޓަރާ ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފި

މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު، އިންޑިއާގެ މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއަރޒް ޑރ. އެސް ޖައިޝަންކަރް އާއި މިއަދު ނިއުދިއްލީގައި ބައްދަލުކުރައްވައިފިއެވެ.

2020 ވަނަ އަހަރުގެ ޖެނުއަރީ މަހު ނިއުދިއްލީއަށް ކުރެއްވި ދަތުރުފުޅުގެ ފަހުން މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ނިއުދިއްލީއަށް ކުރައްވާ ފުރަތަމަ ދަތުރުފުޅުގައި ޑރ ޖައިޝަންކަރާއި މިއަދު ބައްދަލުކުރެއްވީ ހައިދަރްއާބާދު ހައުސްގައެވެ. މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ވަނީ އިންޑިއާއިން ކިޔުއްވި ހޫނު މަރުޙަބާއަށާއި ބަހައްޓަވާ މެހުމާންދާރީއަށް ޑރ ޖައިޝަންކަރަށް ޝުކުރު އަދާކުރައްވާފައެވެ.

މިއަދުގެ ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި ކޮވިޑް-19 އިން ރައްކާތެރިވުމަށް ކުރެވޭ މަސައްކަތާއި، ވެކްސިން ޕްރޮގްރާމްތަކާ ބެހޭ ގޮތުން ދެ ޚާރިޖީ ވަޒީރުން މަޝްވަރާކުރެއްވިއެވެ. އަދި ޕެންޑެމިކްގެ ތެރޭގައި އިންޑިއާއިން ދިވެހި ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ވެދެއްވި އެހީތެރިކަމަށްޓަކައި އިންޑިއާ ސަރުކާރަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ޝުކުރު އަދާކުރެއްވިއެވެ. އެކްސްޓަރނަލް އެފެއަރޒް މިނިސްޓަރ ޑރ ޖައިޝަންކަރު ވަނީ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ އިޖްތިމާޢީ އަދި އިޤްތިޞާދީ ތަރައްޤީއަށް އިންޑިއާއިން ވެދެމުން އަންނަ އެހީތެރިކަން މެދުނުކެނޑި ފޯރުކޮށްދެވާނެކަނުގެ ޔަޤީންކަން ދެއްވާފައެވެ. އެގޮތުން ރާއްޖެއަށް ބޭނުންވާ އަސާސީ މުދާ، އެއްވެސް މެދުކެނޑުމެއް ނެތި ރާއްޖެއަށް ފޯރުކޮށްދެއްވާނެކަމުގެ ޔަޤީންކަން ދެއްވިއެވެ.

en.title: Minister Shahid speaks at the Raisina Dialogue Session entitled “Beyond Covid: Global Public Health after the Pandemic”
en.description: Minister Shahid speaks at the Raisina Dialogue Session entitled “Beyond Covid: Global Public Health after the Pandemic”
en.body:
Minister Shahid speaks at the Raisina Dialogue Session entitled “Beyond Covid: Global Public Health after the Pandemic”

The Minster of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid, shared his perspectives on vaccine inequality, multilateralism, and recovering from the Covid19 pandemic at the Raisina Dialogue session entitled, “Beyond Covid: Public Health after the pandemic”.

He was joined at the panel by Minister of Sports and Youth Affairs of Sri Lanka Namal Rajapaksa, Minister of State for Foreign Affairs of Bangladesh Shahriar Alam, and Senior Fellow, Health Initiative, at the Observer Research Foundation, Shoba Suri. Policy Advisor at the Ministry of External Affairs of India, Ashok Malik, moderated the session.

Minister Shahid highlighted that vaccine inequality results in perpetuating the existing inequalities in the international system, especially between the “haves” and the “have nots”.

The Minister also shared the Maldives experience with the Covid19 pandemic, and the pathways to recovery adopted by the country. He highlighted the key role that the support of international partners played in building resilience against the pandemic, noting that “this Government firmly believes small States survive in an interconnected global economy, relying on the strength and closeness of their international partners”. Minister in particular, noted the exemplary support received from India, throughout the pandemic, and in recovery, including the establishment of the Air Travel Bubble between the Maldives and India, and the gifting of 200,000 doses of vaccines.

The Raisina Dialogue is an annual conference hosted by the Observer Research Foundation, in collaboration with the Ministry of External Affairs, Government of India. The Minister is participating in the Raisina Dialogue on the invitation of the President of the Observer Research Foundation, Mr. Samir Saran. The 2021 edition of the Raisina Dialogue is being held virtually from 13-15 April 2021, due to extenuating circumstances related to the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic.

en.title: Minister Shahid holds telephone call with Minister of Foreign Affairs of France
en.description: Minister Shahid holds telephone call with Minister of Foreign Affairs of France
en.body:
Minister Shahid holds telephone call with Minister of Foreign Affairs of France

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid, held a telephone call with his French counterpart, Jean-Yves Le Drian today.

During the call, both Ministers discussed avenues for enahncing bilateral and multilateral cooperation between the two countries.

Minister Shahid thanked France for the continued assistance to the Maldives at all times and expressed hope for continued cooperation in areas of mutual concern for the two countries.

en.title: Minister Shahid to visit India
en.description: Minister Shahid will visit India from 15-16 April 2021.
en.body:
Minister Shahid will visit India from 15-16 April 2021.

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Maldives Abdulla Shahid will visit India from 15-16 April 2021.

During the visit, Minister Shahid will meet his counterpart Minister of External Affairs of India Dr Jaishankar and discuss bilateral and multilateral issues of mutual interest.

The purpose of the visit is to review progress on bilateral cooperation, and discuss the implementation of key developmental projects under the Indian Lines of Credit extended to the Maldives.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid meets with Minister of Foreign Affairs of Portugal
en.description: Foreign Minister Shahid held a virtual meeting with his Portuguese counterpart.
en.body:
Foreign Minister Shahid held a virtual meeting with his Portuguese counterpart.

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Maldives, Abdulla Shahid held a virtual meeting with the Minister of Foreign Affairs of Portugal, His Excellency Augusto Santos Silva today.

Discussions were held on cooperation at the multilateral fora in addressing climate change and environmental issues, with special focus on Ocean Action. Noting the importance of oceans for both countries, the Ministers expressed the importance of finding creative solutions at the UN Ocean Conference to be held in Lisbon.

Further discussions were held on enhancing bilateral cooperation between the two countries, and reinvigorating people-to-people contact between the two countries.

en.title: Minister Shahid holds a virtual meeting with the Foreign Minister of São Tomé and Príncipe
en.description: Minister Shahid holds a virtual meeting with the Foreign Minister of São Tomé and Príncipe
en.body:
Minister Shahid holds a virtual meeting with the Foreign Minister of São Tomé and Príncipe

Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, Abdulla Shahid held a virtual meeting with the Minister of Foreign Affairs, Cooperation and Community of the Democratic Republic of São Tomé and Príncipe, Edite Ten Jua this evening.

During the meeting, the two Ministers conversed on shared priorities in the international fora, as Small Island Developing States (SIDS), including sea level rise, climate change, and sustainable development. Both Ministers further spoke on the situation of the ongoing Covid-19 pandemic, and the measures in place to mitigate its effects and strive towards a complete and comprehensive recovery, in their respective countries. The two Ministers also discussed enhancing bilateral ties between the two countries and increasing cooperation and sharing of expertise in the field of tourism.

Minister Shahid and Minister Edite Ten Jua reaffirmed their commitment towards elevating cooperation between the two countries, both bilaterally and multilaterally, going ahead.

en.title: Minister Shahid holds virtual interaction with Permanent Representatives of the Africa Group at the United Nations

en.body:
Permanent Representatives and representatives from a number of African countries took part in the meeting

The Minister of Foreign Affairs Abdulla Shahid today, held a virtual interaction with the Permanent Representatives of the Africa Group at the United Nations. Permanent Representatives and representatives from a number of African countries took part in the meeting.

During the meeting, the Minister highlighted the civilizational links between the African countries and the Maldives, and the alignment of interest on many issues in the multilateral arena, including financing for development, sustainable development, climate change, and the importance of multilateralism.

Minister Shahid thanked the representatives of the Africa Group for the opportunity to meet with them, and highlighted the importance of working together to enhance the multilateral system and international cooperation.

en.title: Chinese Ambassador pays Farewell Call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs
en.description: Ambassador Zhang is the 3rd Ambassador of China since the opening of Chinese Embassy in Maldives in 2011.
en.body:
Ambassador Zhang is the 3rd Ambassador of China since the opening of Chinese Embassy in Maldives in 2011.

The Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to the Maldives, His Excellency Mr Zhang Lizhong made a farewell call on the Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid this afternoon at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Foreign Minister Shahid conveyed his sincere gratitude and appreciation for the immense efforts made by the Ambassador to strengthen bilateral ties between Maldives and China, and the generous support he had extended to the Maldives during his ambassadorial tenure.

Ambassador Zhang expressed his positive sentiments, and reiterated his own commitment to continue working closely with the Government of Maldives in all aspects of the bilateral relationship between the two countries. He mentioned that he found the Maldives and the Maldivian people to be hospitable and unique, and thanked the Government for the support it had extended to the friendly people and the Government of China.

Foreign Minister Shahid acknowledged the warmth and affection with which the Maldivian people have come to regard the Ambassador due the efforts he has taken to facilitate development in the country and for his active engagement with the local community. He personally thanked the Ambassador for his efforts in assisting the Maldives during the COVID-19 pandemic. Foreign Minister Shahid mentioned that while he wishes the Ambassador good fortune and success in all his future endeavors, he will always be welcome to visit the country again as a friend of the Maldives.

en.title: Foreign Minister Shahid sends a Congratulatory Message to the New Foreign Minister of Viet Nam
en.description: Minister Shahid sends a congratulatory message to the newly appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs of Viet Name
en.body:
Minister Shahid sends a congratulatory message to the newly appointed Minister of Foreign Affairs of Viet Name

The Minister of Foreign Affairs of Maldives, His Excellency Abdulla Shahid sends a congratulatory message to His Excellency Bui Thanh Son, for being appointed as the new Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam.

Minister’s message read as follows:

“It is my pleasure to extend to Your Excellency my heartfelt congratulations on your appointment as Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam.

Maldives and Viet Nam have enjoyed over four decades of close bonds based on mutual respect and trust. I have no doubt that the existing ties of friendship and cooperation between our two countries will further strengthen and be reinforced during your term in office.

I look forward to working closely with Your Excellency and the Government of Viet Nam in further enhancing our close bilateral relations during your tenure.

Let me also convey my best wishes for Your Excellency’s good health and well-being, as well as for the continued progress and prosperity for the people of Viet Nam.

Please accept, Excellency, the assurances of my highest consideration "

en.title: Joint Press Release - First Meeting of India-Maldives Joint Working Group on Counter-Terrorism, Countering Violent Extremism and De-radicalisation
en.description: First Meeting of India-Maldives Joint Working Group on Counter-Terrorism, Countering Violent Extremism and De-radicalisation
en.body:
First Meeting of India-Maldives Joint Working Group on Counter-Terrorism, Countering Violent Extremism and De-radicalisation

The First Meeting of the Joint Working Group on Counter Terrorism, Countering Violent Extremism and De-Radicalisation between India and the Maldives was held in New Delhi on April 8, 2021. The Indian side was led by Secretary (West) Mr. Vikas Swarup, Ministry of External Affairs and the Maldivian side was led by Foreign Secretary Mr Abdul Ghafoor Mohamed. The meeting was held in a cordial and constructive atmosphere that symbolises the time-tested and good neighbourly ties between India and the Maldives and the energy, ambition and scale acquired by our bilateral relations under the leadership of PM Narendra Modi and President Ibrahim Mohamed Solih.

India and the Maldives strongly condemned terrorism in all its forms and manifestations including cross-border terrorism and emphasised the need for strengthening international cooperation to combat terrorism in a comprehensive and sustained manner. Both sides reviewed threats posed by terrorist entities that are under UN sanctions and emphasised the need for concerted action against all terrorist networks. They underlined the urgent need for all countries to take immediate, sustained, verifiable and irreversible action to ensure that no territory under their control is used for terrorist attacks on others and to expeditiously bring to justice the perpetrators of such attacks.

Referring to the Joint Statement issued during the State Visit of PM Modi to the Maldives in June 2019, the two sides recognised the critical threats that terrorism, violent extremism and radicalisation pose to peace and security in the region. India appreciated the clear-eyed stance taken by the Government of President Solih to counter such threats and the concrete steps taken by the Maldives in this regard.

The two sides also exchanged views on various areas of cooperation in the sphere of counter-terrorism including countering radicalisation and violent extremism, combating financing of terrorism, preventing exploitation of the internet for terrorism and violent extremism, information sharing, capacity building and establishing institutional linkages between police, security forces, customs, immigration and other relevant agencies. Further, the two sides exchanged views on enhancing bilateral cooperation against narcotics and drug trafficking. The discussions were also informed by the challenges that the COVID-19 pandemic has presented to countering terrorism, radicalisation and violent extremism.

Both sides agreed to strengthen cooperation that will include assistance and capacity building for the security and law enforcement agencies and other relevant agencies of the Maldives as well as collaboration and the exchange of best practices in the areas of counter-terrorism, preventing and countering of violent extremism and de-radicalisation . The two sides also discussed cooperation in multilateral fora.

The Maldivian delegation will also visit the training facilities of National Security Guard and the Bureau of Police Research and Development during its stay in New Delhi.

dv.title: ޗައިނާގެ ސަފީރު ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދުގެ އަރިހަށް ވަދާއީ ޒިޔާރަތް ކުރައްވައިފި
dv.description: ޗައިނާގެ ސަފީރު ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދުގެ އަރިހަށް ވަދާއީ ޒިޔާރަތް ކުރައްވައިފި
dv.body:
ޗައިނާގެ ސަފީރު ފޮރިން މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދުގެ އަރިހަށް ވަދާއީ ޒިޔާރަތް ކުރައްވައިފި

ޗައިނާއިން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ކަނޑައަޅާފައިހުންނަވާ ސަފީރު، ޖަންގ ލިޖޮންގް، މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދުގެ އަރިހަށް ވަދާއީ ޒިޔާރަތް މިއަދު ކުރައްވައިފިއެވެ. މިއަދު މެންދުރުފަހު މިނިސްޓްރީ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއަރޒްގައި އޮތް މި ބައްދަލުވުމުގައި، ޗައިނާއާއި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ބަދަހިކުރުމަށް އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޖަންގ ކުރެއްވި މިންނެތް މަސައްކަތަށާއި، އެމަނިކުފާނުގެ ސަފީރުކަމުގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ވެދެއްވި އެހީތަކަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދުވަނީ ޝުކުރު ދަންނަވާފައެވެ. ކުރިއަށް އޮތްތަނުގައިވެސް ޚާރިޖީ ގުޅުމުގެ ތެރެއިން ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ގާތުން މަސައްކަތް ކުރައްވާނެކަމުގެ ޔަގީންކަން އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޖަންގ ދެއްވިއެވެ. އަދި ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ދިވެހިން އެމަނިކުފާނާއި ބެހެއްޓެވި ގާތްކަމާއި މެހުމާންދާރީއަށާއި، ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރުން ޗައިނާގެ ސަރުކާރާއި ޗައިނާގެ ރައްޔިތުންނަށް ދެއްވި އެއްބާރުލުމަށް އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޖަންގވަނީ ޝުކުރުދަންނަވާފައެވެ. ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ތަރައްގީއާއި، އިޖްތިމާޢީ ކަންކަމުގައި ދެއްވި އެއްބާރުލުމުގެ ސަބަބުން ދިވެހިންގެ މެދުގައި އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޖަންގގެ މަގުބޫލުކަން މިނިސްޓަރ ޝަހިދުވަނީ ފާހަގަ ކުރައްވާފައެވެ. އަދި ކޮވިޑް-19 ގެ ހީނަރުކަމުން އަރައިގަތުމަށް ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ވެދެއްވި އެހީއަށް އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޖަންގއަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ޝުކުރުދެންނެވިއެވެ. އަދި ކުރިއަށް އޮތްތަނުގައި އެމަނިކުފާނު ކުރައްވާ މަސައްކަތްތައް ކާމިޔާބުވާނެކަމަށް އުއްމީދު ކުރައްވާކަމަށާއި، ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއިން އަބަދުވެސް އެމަނިކުފާނަށް މަރުހަބާ ދަންނަވާނެކަމަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ވިދާޅުވިއެވެ.

en.title: Minister of Foreign Affairs Attends the Virtual Farewell Reception for the Chinese Ambassador
en.description: Ambassador Zhang arrived in the Maldives in August 2017 and is the third ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to the Maldives
en.body:
Ambassador Zhang arrived in the Maldives in August 2017 and is the third ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to the Maldives

Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid today attended the Virtual Farewell Reception of the Ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to the Maldives, His Excellency Mr. Zhang Lizhong.

While addressing the function, Minister thanked Ambassador Zhang’s sincere contributions to further promoting the close bilateral relations between the two countries during his tenure as Ambassador, as well as for his personal commitment in overseeing the successful implementation of various developmental projects that were conducted with the assistance of the Chinese Government.

Minister Shahid recalled that Ambassador Zhang has been an active member of the Diplomatic Corp, engaging closely with local communities through various assistance programmes, and also working in close collaboration with the Government of Maldives both on issue in the international sphere and on improving the bilateral partnership and friendship between Maldives and China. Minister Shahid mentioned that Ambassador Zhang will be missed by the Maldivian people, and expressed his best wishes to the Ambassador in his future endeavours.

Ambassador Zhang arrived in the Maldives in August 2017 and is the third ambassador of the People’s Republic of China to the Maldives following the opening of the Chinese Embassy in Male’ in 2011. The Reception organized by the Embassy of China was attended by Ministers, Members of the People’s Majlis, the Diplomatic Corp and high-level officials from Government and private sectors.

dv.title: ޗައިނާ ސަފީރުގެ ވަދާއީ ހަފްލާގައި މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ވަރޗުއަލްކޮށް ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގެންފި
dv.description: އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޖަންގް ލިޖޮންގްއަކީ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގައި ޗައިނާގެ އެމްބަސީއެއް 2011 ގައި ހުޅުވިފަހުން ޗައިނާއިން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ކަނޑައެޅުއްވި 3 ވަނަ ސަފީރެވެ.
dv.body:
އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޖަންގް ލިޖޮންގްއަކީ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގައި ޗައިނާގެ އެމްބަސީއެއް 2011 ގައި ހުޅުވިފަހުން ޗައިނާއިން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ކަނޑައެޅުއްވި 3 ވަނަ ސަފީރެވެ.

ޗައިނާއިން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ކަނޑައަޅާފައި ހުންނަވާ ސަފީރު، ޖަންގ ލިޖޮންގްގެ ސަފީރުކަމުގެ ދައުރު ފުރިހަމަކުރެއްވުމާ ގުޅިގެން ބޭއްވި ވަދާއީ ހަފްލާގައި މިނިސްޓަރ އޮފް ފޮރިން އެފެއާޒް ޢަބްދުﷲ ޝާހިދު ވަރޗުއަލްކޮށް ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގެންފިއެވެ.

ހަފްލާގައި ވާހަކަފުޅު ދައްކަވަމުން މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދު ވަނީ ޗައިނާއާއި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ގުޅުން އިތުރަށް ބަދަހިކުރުމަށް ކުރެއްވި މަސައްކަތަށާއި، ޗައިނާ ސަރުކާރުގެ އެހީގައި ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގައި ހިންގުނު އެތަކެއް މަޝްރޫތަކަށް ދެއްވި އެއްބާރުލުމަށް އެމްބެސެޑަރ ލިޖޮންގްއަށް ޝުކުރުދަންނަވާފައެވެ.

އެމްބެސެޑަރ ލިޖޮންގްއަކީ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގެ ޑިޕްލޮމެޓިކް ކޯރގައި ވަރަށް ހަރަކާތްތެރި ބޭފުޅެއްކަމާއި، ބައިނަލްއަގުވާމީ މައްސަލަތަކުގައިއާއި، ޚާރިޖީގޮތުން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއާއި ޗައިނާގެ ގުޅުން ބަދަހިކުރުމަށް ދިވެހި ސަރުކާރާއި ވަރަށް ގާތުން ގުޅިގެން މަސައްކަތްކުރެއްވި ބޭފުޅެއްކަމަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ޝާހިދުގެ ވާހަކަފުޅުގައި ފާހަގަކުރައްވިއެވެ. އަދި އެމްބެސެޑަރ ލިޖޮންގގެ މަސައްކަތް ދިވެހިން ހަނދާން ހުންނާނެކަމަށް މިނިސްޓަރ ވިދާޅުވިއެވެ.

އެމްބެސެޑަރ ޖަންގް ލިޖޮންގްއަކީ ދިވެހިރާއްޖޭގައި ޗައިނާގެ އެމްބަސީއެއް 2011 ގައި ހުޅުވިފަހުން ޗައިނާއިން ދިވެހިރާއްޖެއަށް ކަނޑައެޅުއްވި 3 ވަނަ ސަފީރެވެ. އެމަނިކުފާނު ސަފީރުކަމާއި ހަވާލުވީ އޮގަސްޓް 2017 ގައެވެ.

ޗައިނާ އެމްބަސީއިން އިންތިޒާމުކުރި ވަދާއީ ހަފްލާގައި ދައުލަތުގެ ވަޒީރުންނާއި ރައްޔިތުންގެ މަޖިލީހުގެ މެމްބަރުން، ޑިޕްލޮމެޓިކް ކޯރގެ މެމްބަރުން، އަދި ސަރުކާރާއި ޕްރައިވެޓް ސެކްޓަރގެ އިސް ބޭފުޅުން ބައިވެރިވެވަޑައިގަތެވެ.

en.title: Minister Shahid sends a message of condolence to Foreign Minister of Indonesia
en.description: Minister Shahid sent a message of condolence to Her Excellency Retno L.P. Marsudi, Minister for Foreign Affairs of Indonesia
en.body:
Minister Shahid sent a message of condolence to Her Excellency Retno L.P. Marsudi, Minister for Foreign Affairs of Indonesia

Minister of Foreign Affairs His Excellency Abdulla Shahid sent a message of condolence to Her Excellency Retno L.P. Marsudi, Minister for Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia, following the devastating flash floods and landslides in East Nusa Tenggara province of Indonesia.

Minister’s message reads as follows:

"I am greatly saddened to hear the news of loss of lives and livelihoods, and destruction of homes caused by torrential rains and flash floods in the East Nusa Tenggara province of Indonesia.

At this time of national distress, on behalf of the Government and the people of Maldives, I extend our deepest sympathies to the Government and the brotherly people of Indonesia, especially to the families who lost their loved ones and livelihoods.

I hope that the rescue and recovery operations continue smoothly and commend the tenacity of the people of Indonesia during this crisis."
